subject: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan

Priyom / Lauren —

Quick handoff: NovaMed (contact: Alex Rossi) closed last week, seats + Dedicated capacity committed. They want to onboard next week and start with a staging integration before prod cutover. Key asks I captured:

- Initial API keys for staging + prod (service account preferred)
- Project structure: dev/stage/prod projects for their SRE team
- Role mapping: owners/eng/ops for team invites
- Network: IP allowlist + egress endpoints (IT will need firewall CIDRs)
- Audit logging and retention: 90 days for now

I've attached the onboarding checklist and network requirements they already shared. Alex asked for a short runbook we can hand to their SREs and a proposed invite schedule.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Priyom to draft access plan + service account details
2) Lauren to prepare roles mapping and skeleton invites
3) Karthik to confirm Dedicated pool capacity and rollout window

Thanks — please add anything I missed.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: nova_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan

Thanks Monica — grabbing this. Quick clarifying Qs so I can put together the runbook:

- Do they prefer short-lived API keys (rotated via our console) or a service-account-style long-lived key that their automation will store in a vault? Alex mentioned "service account preferred" but I want to confirm recommended cadence.
- For projects: do they want separate Redwood projects per environment or a single project with role scoping? (we often advise separate projects for clearer billing boundaries)

I'll draft a one-page runbook for SREs with step-by-step: invite, service account creation, key provisioning, IP allowlist, and verification tests. Will also include the minimal API call example with expected 200 body.

Target: share first draft by EOD tomorrow.

—Priyom
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan

Adding the proposed role mapping and schedule. Attached a CSV with suggested roles and permissions (scopes_roles_mapping.csv). Summary below: 

- Projects: recommend separate Redwood projects for staging and prod. Add a temporary dev project if they want a sandbox.
- Roles:
  - Project Owner: billing + admin (1-2 people)
  - Engineer: generation + embeddings access (team-level invites)
  - SRE/Operator: network & keys (can rotate keys)
  - ReadOnly Auditor: logs + cost reports

Proposed invite cadence (week of onboarding):
- Day 0 (Mon): Owner invites + SRE onboarding call
- Day 1 (Tue): Create service account in staging, generate keys, run verification tests
- Day 2 (Wed): Full traffic smoke test from staging; rotate keys if needed
- Day 3 (Thu): Prod project creation + sign-off; set retention and logging

Drive folder with runbook + templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novamed-onboarding

Let me know if we should compress the schedule — Alex flagged they want "as fast as possible" but also want their IT to validate CIDR ranges.

—Lauren
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: scopes_roles_mapping.csv (csv)
From: Alex Rossi <alex.rossi@novamed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@novamed.com>, contracts@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan

Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear plan. A few things from IT side: 

- We prefer service-account keys stored in HashiCorp Vault; long-lived keys are OK but we'd like rotation guidance (recommended 90 days).
- Please confirm the list of egress IPs we need to allow; our firewall team will schedule a maintenance window.
- For auditing, 90 days retention is fine, but can you confirm whether token-level cost breakdown is included in the audit exports?

We can commit to the schedule but need the exact CIDR list and a short verification script. Also, do you support provisioning a single service account scoped to staging and a separate one for prod? That's our preferred model.

Alex Rossi
Director of SRE, NovaMed Health
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rossi <alex.rossi@novamed.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaMed onboarding — access & API key plan

Alex — thanks, pulling this together. Answers inline and next steps below.

- Keys: we will provision two service accounts (staging, prod). Each will have a long-lived key that we recommend rotating every 90 days; we include a rotation script sample in the runbook.
- IPs: our Dedicated egress ranges for the us-west region are: 54.183.12.0/24, 54.183.13.0/24, 54.183.14.0/24. I'll add these to the runbook and send a one-line curl verification you can run from your firewall test machine.
- Audits: token-level cost + per-request latency is available in the audit export; we'll include an example JSON export and instructions to pull it from the Console.

Action items I will deliver by EOD tomorrow (Thu):
1) One-page SRE runbook (service account creation, key download, Vault ingestion, test curl) — attached to Drive.
2) IP allowlist snippet and verification script — included in runbook.
3) DocuSign link for the onboarding SOW (contracts@novamed.com) — will send once Karthik confirms capacity.

Karthik — can you confirm Dedicated pool availability for the week of Jun 21 and drop an ETA here? If we get confirmation, we'll lock the invite cadence and send calendar invites.

—Priyom
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: nova_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_requirements.pdf (pdf)
